gloss: web conference; online meeting; video conference

definitions.gloss: web conference; online meeting; video conference
definitions.explanation: a meeting conducted over the internet using video and audio communication

examples.japanese: ウェブ{会議|かいぎ}で{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせをする。
examples.english: To have a meeting via web conference.

examples.japanese: ウェブ{会議|かいぎ}の{回数|かいすう}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: The number of web conferences has increased.

examples.japanese: ウェブ{会議|かいぎ}のおかげで{在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ}ができる。
examples.english: Thanks to web conferences, I can work from home.

notes:

- Microsoft Teams

POST-PANDEMIC WORK:
ウェブ{会議|かいぎ} became a standard business practice during and after the COVID-19 pandemic, enabling {在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ} (working from home) and ハイブリッド{勤務|きんむ} (hybrid work).
